question: Please provide the top 10 tree species in New York, using their uppercase Latin names where the Latin name is not empty and including their common names, showing the total number of trees, the counts of alive and dead trees for each year, and the corresponding growth in these counts from 1995 to 2015, then order by the difference in total tree counts between these years.
sql:
WITH y1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS spc_latin,
    ARRAY_AGG(spc_common ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS spc_common,
    SUM(cnt) AS total_1995,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('Good', 'Excellent', 'Fair', 'Poor', 'Critical') THEN cnt ELSE 0 END) AS alive_1995,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Dead' THEN cnt ELSE 0 END) AS dead_1995
  FROM (
    SELECT spc_latin, spc_common, status, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
    WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
    GROUP BY spc_latin, spc_common, status
  )
  GROUP BY spc_latin
),
y2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS spc_latin,
    ARRAY_AGG(spc_common ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS spc_common,
    SUM(cnt) AS total_2015,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Alive' THEN cnt ELSE 0 END) AS alive_2015,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Dead' THEN cnt ELSE 0 END) AS dead_2015
  FROM (
    SELECT spc_latin, spc_common, status, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
    WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
    GROUP BY spc_latin, spc_common, status
  )
  GROUP BY spc_latin
)
SELECT 
  a.spc_latin,
  COALESCE(b.spc_common, a.spc_common) AS spc_common,
  a.total_1995,
  b.total_2015,
  a.alive_1995,
  b.alive_2015,
  a.dead_1995,
  b.dead_2015,
  b.total_2015 - a.total_1995 AS growth_total,
  b.alive_2015 - a.alive_1995 AS growth_alive,
  b.dead_2015 - a.dead_1995 AS growth_dead
FROM y1995 a
INNER JOIN y2015 b ON a.spc_latin = b.spc_latin
ORDER BY growth_total DESC
LIMIT 10
